facts.text: Singapore is a Southeast Asian city-state.
English, Mandarin, Malay, and Tamil are official languages.

culture.text: Hawker centers bring together Chinese, Malay, Indian, and other food traditions in shared public dining spaces.

food.name: Hainanese chicken rice
food.text: Chicken accompanies fragrant rice cooked in broth, with sauces served on the side.
